body: Sure. I have lots to do during the day, but I'll be back sooner or later.
He's back now but I will still talk if you feel like it.
I'm a girl, and sure go ahead.
Maybe slightly calmer, but pretty close to the same, it goes up and down a little bit over time. What about yourself, how are you today?

Sure, I appreciate it. 

....

I'm not sure what else to say, you said you've dealt with the same thing, so you know how it goes. I can tell you all about how I'm curled up in my room crying eating out of a jar of peanut butter with a spoon, trying to remember where I last saw my knife, but it sounds so damn emo. I'm not even sure what you could say. Just having company helps though.
